subject: Chalk
body:
Ritual Chalk! Now the real witchcraft starts.

Draw your circles carefully. Stomping around carelessly will ruin them. Here's one drawn properly so you know what you're aiming for, and there's a page on chalk in the book. @archive:integrated_boogaloo:witchery_rituals @display:integrated_boogaloo:guide/rite_summon_imp
